label: Begun coming-to-be control checked (inference)
rule: Explicit interpretations with WithBot Int and non-negative rational times, checked by case analysis, induction on accessibility, linear arithmetic and halving
meaning: Strictness and nonvacuity: begun coming-to-be is possible while founded coming-to-be is not, so the founded version strictly strengthens the begun one. In the same interpretation every contingent individual has an earlier-present existing predecessor that the control's grounding relation relates to it, yet no individual is necessary at either world: an endless descent of contingent grounds fits between the empty first moment and any later moment, and inert emptiness fails. So the begun coming-to-be plus earlier-present-grounds bundle does not entail a necessary individual; in the spine's existing route, necessity is supplied by inert emptiness (A2) together with the route's other premises. The non-negative rational conjunct checks that continuous time with a beginning gives every moment a begun past and no moment after 0 a founded one. Model claims concern these interpretations only.
